name: Chanel No. 5
description: An iconic floral aldehyde fragrance, timeless and elegant. A symphony of rose and jasmine atop a warm woody musk base. The quintessential feminine fragrance that defined modern perfumery.

name: Sauvage
description: Raw and noble, a wild and fresh composition. Bergamot from Calabria bursts open with a peppery spice that gives way to a dry woody base with ambroxan. The scent of raw freedom.

name: Black Orchid
description: A luxurious and sensual fragrance of rich, dark accords and an alluring potion of black orchids. Dark, deep, and hypnotic with notes of chocolate, patchouli, and mysterious black orchid.

name: Aventus
description: Inspired by the life of Napoleon Bonaparte, Aventus celebrates strength, power, and success. Opens with fruity pineapple and bergamot that transitions to smoky birch over a musky base.

name: Angel
description: A revolutionary gourmand oriental that changed perfumery forever. Sweet, edible, and celestial — a heavenly clash of patchouli and sweet caramel chocolate that is deeply addictive.

name: Peony & Blush Suede
description: Voluptuous and bold — the exquisite peony is combined with the youthful flush of red apple and a soft, powdery suede. Light, airy, and beautifully feminine. Perfect for warm days.

name: Replica Jazz Club
description: The scent of a jazz club late at night — warm tobacco, spiced rum, and musk. Evocative and cozy with a smooth woody base. Like the memory of smoky music and dimly lit bars.

name: Terre d'Hermès
description: A journey through materials — citrus-mineral freshness gives way to a deep earthy core. Raw, natural, and elemental. The smell of the earth after rain, combined with warm woody spice.

name: Black Opium
description: An addictive gourmand with an edgy rock chic character. Black coffee infused with sweet vanilla, white flowers, and a hint of patchouli darkness. The night's most seductive fragrance.

name: Shalimar
description: The legendary oriental classic, inspired by the Shalimar Gardens of India. A love story in a bottle — rich vanilla, warm spices, and lush florals over a deep smoky base. Timeless sensuality.

name: Bleu de Chanel
description: Freedom, style, and masculinity distilled into one bottle. Citrus freshness blooms into warm woody spice. Clean yet complex, Bleu de Chanel defines contemporary masculine elegance.

name: La Vie Est Belle
description: Life is beautiful — a joyful and sweet floral fragrance. Vibrant iris and sweet praline with soft vanilla create the scent of happiness. Warm, generous, and irresistibly feminine.

name: Oud Wood
description: A rare and exotic oud — smoky, spicy, and rich. Combines rare oud wood with cardamom and sandalwood to create a mysterious and inviting warmth. Intimate and deeply sophisticated.

name: Acqua di Gio
description: A Mediterranean escape in a bottle. The scent of sea, sky, and wind. Crisp marine notes blend with bergamot and warm cedar. The quintessential summer masculine fragrance.

name: Light Blue
description: The essence of the Mediterranean, evocative of Capri. Crisp Sicilian citron and fresh apple blossoms give way to soft bamboo and woods. Light, carefree, and utterly feminine.

name: Flowerbomb
description: A floral explosion — an overdose of flowers, a grenade of femininity. A lush bouquet of rose, orchid, and jasmine anchored by warm patchouli and vanilla. Sweet, bold, and unforgettable.

name: Molecule 01
description: A single molecule — Iso E Super. Woody, cedar-like, and deeply personal. Iso E Super reacts uniquely with each person's skin chemistry, creating an invisible aura that is irresistibly close.

name: Oud Ispahan
description: A grand Persian rose entwined with precious oud wood. Rich, deep, and majestic. Rose and oud create a timeless oriental masterpiece that evokes the gardens and souks of ancient Persia.

name: Coco Mademoiselle
description: Audacious and free — fresh oriental with an orange top note and a bold patchouli dry down. Youthful yet sophisticated, Coco Mademoiselle is the fragrance of the modern Chanel woman.

name: Boss Bottled
description: The fragrance of success — sophisticated and masculine. Apple and spice combine with a rich woody base to create a confident everyday scent. Clean, professional, and timeless.

name: Baccarat Rouge 540
description: A luminous amber floral — sweet, airy, and deeply woody. Jasmine and saffron dissolve into amberwood and cedar creating a radiant, crystalline warmth. The most coveted niche fragrance of the decade.

name: Neroli Portofino
description: The Ligurian coastline in a fragrance. Sparkling citrus and neroli, the luminous Mediterranean sea air, with a warm amber drydown. Pure luxury, the essence of an Italian summer.

name: Tobacco Vanille
description: A rich, smoky, and deeply comforting blend of tobacco and vanilla. Like a cozy fireside with a glass of aged whiskey — warm, spiced, and completely intoxicating. Perfect cold-weather comfort.

name: Good Girl
description: Duality in a bottle — virtue on top, danger within. White floral jasmine and tuberose contrast with addictive coffee and cacao. Bold, seductive, and beautifully complex.

name: Stronger With You
description: A modern romantic masculine — spiced cardamom and pepper bloom into a warm vanilla heart. Sweet, sensual, and irresistibly magnetic. The scent of effortless masculinity.

name: Miss Dior
description: The freshest declaration of love. Rose petals from Grasse bloom with bright mandarin, anchored by green patchouli. Classic, romantic, and deeply feminine — the scent of a love letter.

name: Eros
description: Inspired by the Greek god of love — fresh mint and green apple collide with warm vanilla and tonka. Irresistibly fresh and sensual. Bold, confident, and made to attract.

name: J'adore
description: An absolute femininity — a golden floral bouquet of jasmine, rose, and ylang-ylang. Radiant, luminous, and joyful. J'adore is the essence of Dior femininity.

name: One Million
description: An irresistible blend of luxury and luck. Fresh citrus meets warm leather and spice in this golden masculine. Bold, charismatic, and unforgettable. The scent of pure seduction.

name: Libre
description: Freedom embodied. Lavender — traditionally masculine — becomes ultra-feminine here when married with orange blossom and vanilla. Bold, androgynous, and completely modern.

name: Rose Oud
description: A Middle Eastern dream — the eternal marriage of rose and oud. Rich Turkish rose mingles with precious oud and golden saffron over a warm amber sandalwood base. Opulent and deeply romantic.

name: Fahrenheit
description: Fiery and provocative — a unique violet-leather accord warmed by floral carnation and sweet amber. Fahrenheit burns bright and is unlike anything else. Unforgettably masculine.

name: Chloé Eau de Parfum
description: A pure feminine expression — a fresh, romantic blend of rose and peony. Light, airy, and effortlessly chic. Chloé EDP is the fragrance of effortless Parisian femininity.

name: Spicebomb Extreme
description: Detonate warmth — an intense and fiery oriental spicy masculine. Tobacco and cayenne ignite with cinnamon and lavender, landing on rich vanilla and amber. Bold, warm, and intensely masculine.

name: Pour Homme
description: Clean Mediterranean masculinity — crisp citrus and aromatic herbs over a mossy woody base. Timeless, classic, and utterly inoffensive. The perfect everyday fresh masculine.

name: Twilly d'Hermès
description: Young, bold, and vibrant — a fresh take on spicy floral. Zingy ginger entwines with the lush creaminess of tuberose over warm sandalwood. Youthful energy meets Hermès refinement.

name: Silver Mountain Water
description: The spirit of the Swiss Alps in a bottle. Fresh green tea and bergamot evoke crisp mountain air and glacial water. Clean, pure, and refreshingly natural.

name: Patchouli 24
description: Smoky, campfire patchouli with birch tar and a creamy vanilla base. Raw, animalistic, and deeply earthy. For those who love the scent of nature, fire, and something truly primordial.

name: Santal 33
description: The New York scent of a generation. Warm sandalwood and leather with a violet-iris softness. Intimate, cozy, and utterly addictive. Santal 33 became the signature scent of an entire era.

name: Bal d'Afrique
description: Inspired by African artistry and rhythm — golden marigold, exotic flowers, and earthy musk. Bright, lively, and deeply sensual. A celebration of African culture through scent.

name: Gypsy Water
description: The spirit of Romani freedom — bergamot and pine with a warm amber and vanilla drydown. Fresh yet woody, free-spirited and nomadic. Like walking through a forest on a crisp morning.

name: Ambre Sultan
description: A golden, resinous amber of mythical proportions. Herbal and earthy spices open to warm resins and precious amber. Rich, complex, and deeply meditative. The amber to define all ambers.

name: Iris Nobile
description: Italian elegance in a flacon — the noble iris of Florence surrounded by delicate jasmine and citrus. Powdery, refined, and aristocratic. A masterwork of Italian floral perfumery.

name: Colonia
description: Since 1916, the original Italian citrus cologne. Bright citrus accord with soft lavender and rosemary, drying down to warm musk. Timeless, unisex, and the epitome of Italian sprezzatura.

name: Eau Sauvage
description: The original fresh masculine — refined, wild, and irresistible. The first fragrance to use Hedione, giving it a jasmine freshness unlike anything before. Timeless French elegance.

name: Scandal
description: Sweet, bold, and provocative — honey and caramel blend with rich jasmine over a patchouli base. Sensual, modern, and addictively sweet. For the woman who makes heads turn.

name: Dior Homme
description: A revolutionary masculine — lipstick-powdery iris and lavender with a cocoa warmth. Androgynous and deeply intimate. Dior Homme redefined masculinity in fragrance.

name: Amazonia
description: The rainforest at dawn — vibrant citrus and green ferns over a cedar musk base. Crisp, dewy, and wildly natural. A breath of jungle air, cool and alive.

name: Mon Guerlain
description: Feminine and free — lavender blossoms over a warm vanilla and sandalwood base. A modern floral oriental that captures effortless femininity. Soft, dreamy, and comforting.

name: Ambrosia di Fiori
description: Floral nectar — a divine blend of Italian citrus and lush white flowers over a soft amber musk. Elegant, bright, and luminous. The Italian notion of la dolce vita distilled into a fragrance.

name: Khamrah
description: A spiced gourmand with rich dates, cinnamon and creamy vanilla tonka. Deeply warm and intoxicating — a celebration in a bottle.

name: Yara
description: A sweet, creamy floral with luscious Tahitian vanilla and orchid. A modern feminine favourite that smells expensive far above its price.

name: Bade'e Al Oud Amethyst
description: A regal oud-saffron composition with rose and amber. Deep, smoky and unapologetically Arabian.

name: Asad
description: A bold, smoky woody fragrance — green apple bite over a rugged oud-birch base. A confident daily masculine.

name: Fakhar
description: A sweet-spicy masculine with apple, cinnamon and warm tonka. Often compared to luxury niche houses at a fraction of the price.

name: Aristocrat
description: A clean, sharp masculine fougère — fresh mint and cedar over a polished vetiver base. Office-friendly and refined.

name: Amber Wood
description: A warm amber-oud composition with saffron and creamy sandalwood. Reminiscent of luxury Arabian attars.

name: Wisal
description: An opulent rose-oud feminine with saffron and amber. Sensual, sophisticated and unmistakably Middle Eastern.

name: Hawas
description: A fresh aquatic masculine with sage and juniper over woody ambergris. Often compared to Creed Aventus at a fraction of the cost.

name: La Yuqawam
description: A juicy pineapple opening over smoky birch — fresh, fruity and assertive. A confident crowd-pleaser.

name: Shaghaf Oud
description: An intoxicating rose-oud-saffron blend, rich and creamy. The kind of fragrance that turns heads at any gathering.

name: Dirham
description: A bright citrus-fruity opening with a clean vetiver dry-down. Crisp, easygoing and ideal for daytime wear.

name: L'Aventure
description: An elegant apple-lavender fougère with a sophisticated woody base. A favourite among Indian fragrance enthusiasts for its longevity.

name: Amber Oud Gold Edition
description: A luxurious amber-oud with sweet vanilla undertones. Warm, sensual and long-lasting — perfect for cooler weather.

name: Club de Nuit Intense Man
description: The legendary 'Aventus clone' — smoky pineapple over birch and ambergris. Massive value for the price and a staple in any masculine collection.

name: Ventana
description: A clean, breezy citrus-lavender daily driver. Polite enough for the office, fresh enough for warm days.

name: 9 PM
description: A sweet-spicy evening masculine with apple, cardamom and warm vanilla tonka. A modern crowd-pleaser.

name: Supremacy Silver
description: A bright aquatic masculine in the Aventus family — citrus and ambergris with a smooth musky base.

name: Hayaati
description: A warm amber-floral with creamy sandalwood. Cozy, comforting and easy to wear.

name: Oud Mood
description: A bold, smoky oud composition with rose and spice. Traditional Middle Eastern character at an accessible price.

name: Club de Nuit Women
description: A polished Coco Mademoiselle homage — citrusy opening, rose-jasmine heart, refined patchouli musk. Office-elegant and crowd-pleasing.

name: Raindrops
description: A dewy, fresh floral with juicy apricot and tuberose. Light, breezy and easy to wear — a Reddit darling for daily feminine use.

name: Shaghaf Oud Ahmar
description: The red Shaghaf — a sweeter, vanilla-laced rose-oud. Cozy, sensual, deeply romantic and forgiving for newcomers to oud.

name: Delilah
description: A modern, clean floral with pear and rose. Commonly compared to Delina — fresh, feminine, never overwhelming.

name: Dirham Wardi
description: The rose-forward variant of Dirham — bright citrus over fresh rose, clean musky base. Light, unisex, and very easy to wear.

name: Angham
description: A sweet rose-saffron with creamy amber and warm spice. Sensual, opulent and unmistakably oriental.

name: Untold
description: A Delina-inspired floral — fresh rose, soft musk and a touch of sweetness. Modern, feminine, very wearable.

name: Asad Bourbon
description: A warm rum-tobacco masculine with apple and lavender. Smooth, slightly boozy, made for cold evenings and confident wearers.

name: Layali
description: A sweet, creamy floral-gourmand often compared to Lattafa Yara. Soft vanilla orchid, very approachable.

name: Eclaire
description: A sweet pistachio-caramel gourmand with a citrus opening — dessert-like, playful and addictive.

name: Bade'e Al Oud Oud for Glory
description: A bold lavender-oud composition often cited as a Penhaligon's Oud clone. Smoky, herbal and refined.

name: Hawas Ice
description: An icy, mentholated take on Hawas — fresh apple-mint over aquatic ambergris. Built for hot weather and gyms.
